releaseNotes: LifeOS v1.2.1 (Build 3): Performance optimization release. Eliminates GPU blur on blob (radial-gradient), removes layout-reflow height animations (scaleY+opacity), fixes 300ms tap delay (touch-action:manipulation), removes MutationObserver from main thread, wraps hub navigation in startTransition, fixes More button double-toggle with AnimatePresence popLayout mode and animation guard, and skips service worker in native APK.
